mod.title: Wuxia: The New Dawn
ui.breakthrough.failed: {0} failed the breakthrough and suffered a Qi Deviation: lost all Qi and half the progress, and cannot cultivate for {1} hours.
realm.budding.name: Budding Root
realm.budding.desc: The first step: the body begins to sense the Qi of heaven and earth.
realm.qi_condensation.name: Qi Condensation
realm.qi_condensation.desc: Qi gathers and condenses in the meridians. Breaking through needs the Foundation Establishment Elixir.
realm.foundation.name: Foundation
realm.foundation.desc: The foundation of cultivation is set; the body starts to exceed mortal limits.
realm.core_formation.name: Core Formation
realm.core_formation.desc: Qi begins to gather into a core in the Dantian. Life grows longer.
realm.core_coagulation.name: Core Coagulation
realm.core_coagulation.desc: The core solidifies. Heat and cold barely matter anymore.
realm.spirit_core.name: Spirit Core
realm.spirit_core.desc: The core gains a spirit of its own and becomes immaculate.
realm.spirit_transformation.name: Spirit Transformation
realm.spirit_transformation.desc: A shackle that is hard to break. Breaking through needs Pure Yang Qi.
realm.nascent_soul.name: Nascent Soul
realm.nascent_soul.desc: A spirit soul is born in the Dantian. Barely needs food or sleep.
realm.great_accomplishment.name: Great Accomplishment
realm.great_accomplishment.desc: The soul matures; the body heals itself quickly.
realm.body_integration.name: Body Integration
realm.body_integration.desc: Soul and body become one. Breaking through needs the Immortal Oracle.
realm.terrestrial_immortal.name: Terrestrial Immortal
realm.terrestrial_immortal.desc: An immortal on earth. The peak of cultivation.

root.heavenly.name: Heavenly Root
ui.android_no_cultivation: Androids and robots have no meridians and cannot cultivate.
ui.can_awaken: Has the aptitude to cultivate, but has not awakened yet.
ui.cannot_cultivate: Has no spirit root and cannot cultivate.
ui.coming_soon: Coming soon: skill tree and passives.
ui.meditation_hint: Gains Qi during recreation, and much more on the Meditation Cushion or the Cultivation Platform. A Spiritual Rock nearby gives +50%.

ui.break_bonus: Pill bonus: breakthrough chance +{0}% ({1} h left)
pill.no_cultivation: Has not awakened cultivation: the pill has no cultivation effect.

test.no_root: Test kit: items on the ground. This colonist has no spirit root and cannot cultivate.

ui.ready_item: Ready to break through: use the required item (right-click it).

pill.break_not_ready: Not at the peak of {0} yet: no breakthrough.
